fullData.title: Adding on a Number Line
fullData.subject: Elementary Mathematics

problem.statement: Use the number line below to find the sum of 24 and 13. Start at 24 and make a big jump of 10, then make 3 small jumps of 1 to reach your answer.

fullData.solutionStrategy: Break $13$ into tens and ones to jump forward along the number line in steps of $10$ and $1$.

content.altText: A number line from 20 to 40 with a jump of plus 10 starting at 24 and landing on 34.

annotations.steps: I started at 24 and jumped 10 spaces forward to land on 34.
annotations.strategy: I like to make a big jump of ten first because it is easier to add tens.
annotations.misconceptions: Start at the given number. Count the moves after it, not the starting mark.
annotations.connections: This shows how adding tens on a number line is the same as adding tens in base ten blocks.
annotations.narrative: Start at the point marked $24$ on the number line and make one big jump forward of $10$ to land on tick $34$, since $24 + 10 = 34$.

challenge.prompt: Start at 24 and make a big jump forward of 10. Which number do you land on?
challenge.rationale: Adding 10 to 24 brings you to 34, whereas counting the starting mark 24 as jump 1 mistakenly lands on 33.

content.altText: A number line from 20 to 40 showing three small jumps of plus one from 34 to 37.

annotations.steps: Take three small jumps of one forward from thirty-four to reach thirty-seven.
annotations.strategy: I add the remaining ones one by one to finish adding thirteen.
annotations.misconceptions: Start at the given number. Count the moves after it, not the starting mark.
annotations.connections: Counting by ones is just like moving forward on a ruler.
annotations.narrative: From tick $34$, take $3$ small jumps forward of $1$ to visit ticks $35$, $36$, and land on $37$, which gives the final sum $24 + 13 = 37$.

specs.title: Jump forward by tens
specs.pedagogicalGoal: Understand adding a two-digit number by first making a large jump of ten on the number line.
specs.seedNotes: Render a number line starting at 24 with a jump arc of +10 landing on 34, highlighting 24 + 10 = 34.

specs.title: Count forward by ones
specs.pedagogicalGoal: Complete the addition by taking individual unit jumps from the intermediate milestone to find the total sum.
specs.seedNotes: Continue on the number line from 34 with 3 single jumps of +1 visiting 35 and 36 to land on 37, showing 24 + 13 = 37.
